## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated (fixture + E2E for resolver/adapter changes)
- [ ] No new permissions, host access or manifest security changes (or discussed in an issue first and the snapshot updated)
- [ ] No network requests, analytics or remote code
- [ ] User-facing text uses `t()` and `messages.json`
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed
